prompt_text: I need new tires installed in Pleasanton. Which specific tire shops should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you a specific, prioritized list — phone numbers and short reasons — but first I need two quick clarifications so I tailor it correctly:

1) Which Pleasanton do you mean (Pleasanton, CA is most common)?  
2) Vehicle (make/model) or tire size and any preferences (brand, budget, need same‑day, want road‑hazard warranty, alignment, TPMS service, or mobile installation)?

If you want a quick general answer right now, here are the kinds of shops you should call and why (I’ll make a custom list of exact shops/phones once you confirm location and vehicle):

- Costco Tire Center (nearest Costco): Best prices on many mainstream brands, professional installation, and a strong warranty/return policy — but you must be a member and appointment slots can fill fast. Good if you want value for common sizes.

- Discount Tire / America's Tire / Tire Discounters (nearest large chain): Very large inventory, quick same‑day installs, good pricing and frequent promotions, and experienced techs for mounting/balancing/TPMS. Good if you need fast availability in uncommon sizes.

- Firestone Complete Auto Care or Goodyear Auto Service (local chain location): Convenient if you also want alignment, brakes or other service in the same visit. They offer nationwide warranties and multi-service capability.

- Independent local tire shop in Pleasanton: Often better personalized service, more flexible scheduling, and local knowledge (best option for custom wheels, performance tires, or older cars). Ask about mounting fees, alignment packages, and whether they’ll match competitor prices.

- Mobile tire installers / on‑site service: Good if you can’t get to a shop. They come to your home or work and mount/balance tires on site; typically a convenience premium is charged.

What to ask when you call (so you can compare apples to apples):
- Do you have my tire size in stock (give size)? Price per tire and total installed price? (include taxes/fees)
- What’s included: mounting, balancing, valve stems, disposal fee, TPMS reprogramming, road‑hazard warranty, lifetime rotation?
- Do you offer alignment packages and at what cost (if needed)?
- Earliest appointment or same‑day availability?
- Estimated install time and whether they keep a spare for road hazards?
- Cancellation policy and warranty terms.

If you confirm Pleasanton (and ideally your vehicle/tire size and priorities), I’ll list 6–8 specific shops near you with phone numbers and one‑sentence reasons to call each.
